## Masonry.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `columns` :: How many columns to use, or a map resolved from the element's width against the system's `--bp-*` breakpoints.
- `gap` :: The gap between columns and stacked items.
- `items` :: The items to place, in stable source order.
- `children` :: The content of one item, called with the item and its index.

## masonry.ts

### `type MasonryColumns`

A responsive column map, resolved against the element's width and the system's `--bp-*` breakpoints.

- `base` :: Columns below the `sm` breakpoint.
- `sm` :: Columns from `--bp-sm` (769px) up.
- `md` :: Columns from `--bp-md` (1025px) up.
- `lg` :: Columns from `--bp-lg` (1281px) up.
- `xl` :: Columns from `--bp-xl` (1441px) up.

### `type PackedItem`

- `x` :: Inline offset from the start edge, in pixels (written to `--x`).
- `y` :: Block offset from the top, in pixels (written to `--y`).

### `function supportsMasonry`

Whether the browser supports the CSS masonry grid the brief asks for. SSR-safe: false when `CSS` is unavailable.

### `function packColumns`

Place each item, in source order, into the shortest column. Returns pixel offsets and the packed height (`extent`), gap not included after the last item.
